allowedSourceMaterial.overview: In the aftermath of WWI, a young German who grieves the death of her fiancé in France meets a mysterious French man who visits the fiance’s grave to lay flowers.

facts.title: Frantz

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: What deep bond brought an enigmatic Frenchman across national borders to mourn at a fallen soldier's grave?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: In post-World War I Germany, a young woman mourning the death of her fiancé in France encounters an enigmatic French soldier quietly leaving flowers at the fallen man's grave.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Slow, thoughtful, and emotionally heavy drama that rewards patient, engaged viewing.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Director François Ozon delivers a delicate, emotionally resonant period drama, exploring grief and cross-border reconciliation with patient elegance.
